summary: Avalanche Treasury Corp (Pubco) filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its business combination with Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp (MLAC) and related entities. On June 11, 2026, MLAC domesticated to a Delaware corporation and merged with Pubco's subsidiaries, with Pubco surviving. The transaction was governed by a Business Combination Agreement dated October 1, 2025, and amended in January and March 2026. No specific price per share, premium, or implied value was disclosed. The board recommended the transaction in the proxy statement/prospectus filed May 14, 2026. Registrant became the successor public company. Watch for post-combination trading dynamics and potential redemption impacts.
